_readme: Rewards and anti-abuse settings for CensorCraft. Edit, then run `pnpm build` and re-import the add-on (the file is bundled into the behavior pack).
Each tier: xpLevels (XP levels granted), rolls (how many different entries are drawn from `items` by weight), optional `guaranteed` entries (always given), optional title/subtitle shown on screen.
Each entry: item (vanilla item id), min/max (stack size range), weight (relative chance, default 1), optional enchantments { id: level }.
cooldownSeconds: minimum time between two rewards for one player. dailyRewardCap: rewards per player per real-world day (UTC).
partialCreditMinScore: on Hard, a score from this value up to (not including) 1 earns a reduced reward. rememberedQuestions: how many answered-question hashes are kept per player for reward dedupe.
